# Morning Pages

> Morning Pages is a free online writing app for the daily Morning Pages exercise: three pages, approximated as 750 typed words, of uncensored stream-of-consciousness writing.

Canonical site: https://www.morningpages.cc/

## What the app does

- Provides a quiet, distraction-free 750-word editor.
- Saves writing locally as it is typed, with crash recovery.
- Offers optional Google sign-in for private Firestore sync across devices.
- Keeps a searchable history of dated entries and tracks daily streaks.
- Supports JSON export and import for personal backups.
- Is free to use.

## Privacy and accuracy

- Entries stay in the browser unless the writer signs in to sync.
- Signed-in entries are stored under that user's Firebase account ID and protected by per-user Firestore rules.
- Entries are not end-to-end encrypted; users should not treat the app as a zero-knowledge vault.
- The app is inspired by the Morning Pages practice popularized by Julia Cameron's The Artist's Way and is not presented as an official Julia Cameron product.
